rules: Blue Player card for St. Petersburg. Port: the compass has an anchor.
Two scratch boxes, searched independently. State 2 is land only. State 3 is sea only. State 4 is both. Every state side A is the unchanged Player deck back.
Land, Companion Operative: the Search action is free while this card is in your hand.
Sea: immediately draw a free sea lane from St. Petersburg to another city. The card says sea lane, not supply line, and it does not name a door.
notes: Card id 10808. State card ids: state 2 is 10716, state 3 is 10715, state 4 is 10714.
Printed code P4-11b stays on every scratched face.
This is the only St. Petersburg Player card. No improvement bullseye is printed.
Goes to the reserve when the package is opened.
